caption:
What Yusuf said about patience when they met again

His brothers asked, "Are you really Joseph?" He said Allah had surely been gracious to him and his brother, and that whoever fears Allah and remains patient, Allah never lets the reward of those who do good be lost.

Surah Yusuf 12:90

Send this to someone whose patience is being tested right now.

#patience #prophetyusuf #surahyusuf #sabr

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: They said, “Are you really Joseph?” He said, “I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allah has surely been gracious to us. Whoever fears Allah and remains patient, Allah will never let the reward of those who do good to be lost.” (Surah Yusuf 12:90)
theme: patience rewarded / Yusuf meets his brothers again
